# orders-api configuration module (AWS Lambda)

Generated by `docuconf terraform -target lambda` from the `orders-api` contract. It takes one argument per input, checks it against the contract, and renders a Lambda function's environment variables. See [spec/IAC.md](https://github.com/Docuconf/docuconf-go/blob/main/spec/IAC.md).

| Input | Type | Required | Set with | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | list |  | `value`, `injected` | Origins allowed to call the API from a browser |
| `DATABASE_URL` | url, secret | yes | `injected` | Postgres connection string for the orders database |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | enum |  | `value`, `injected` | Minimum log level emitted |
| `PORT` | int |  | `value`, `injected` | HTTP listen port |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | duration |  | `value`, `injected` | Time limit for handling one request |
| `WEBHOOK_KEYS` | keySet, secret |  | `injected` | Keys that verify the signature on incoming payment webhooks |
| `WORKER_COUNT` | int |  | `value`, `injected` | Number of background workers processing orders |

Lambda mounts no files, so the contract's optional file inputs and overlays are not part of this module.

Lambda resolves no secret references in its environment, so a secret input is `injected`: its `ref`, such as a Secrets Manager or Parameter Store ARN, becomes the variable's value, and the function reads the secret itself, through the AWS Parameters and Secrets Lambda Extension or an SDK, with its execution role allowed to. The secret's value never passes through Terraform. Lambda allows 4096 bytes of environment variables; the `lambda_environment` output refuses more.

## Usage

```hcl
module "orders_api_config" {
  source = "./modules/orders-api-config"
  DATABASE_URL = { injected = { provider = "aws-parameters-and-secrets", ref = aws_secretsmanager_secret.database_url.arn } }
}

resource "aws_lambda_function" "app" {
  # …
  # The environment block's variables are in the plan's configuration, so
  # this reference also binds the function to the module for docuconf lint.
  environment {
    variables = module.orders_api_config.lambda_environment
  }
}
```
